author: Akien
prose: does the trail stay append-only at all, or does a validation collapse to one current record per proof? so here's the thing about building to intentions that i've learned, the validation is a single record. so is the preceeding one. so a ticket should accumulate them? and all we need to keep of a proof is enough data to verify it. So do we need it's whole history? no, in fact it tends to create noise. now where should we draw that line?
